senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בה , v. בְּהַת); (as adj.) m. confounded, abashed, ashamed.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 101a:12">Zeb. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>הודה ולא ביש וכ׳</he> he confessed and was not ashamed so as to say, ‘I have not learned it’, but he said &c.; <cite ref="Zevachim 101b:1">ib.ᵇ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).—
<cite ref="Chagigah 22b:3">Ḥag. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>בּוֹשְׁנִי</he> = <he>בוש אני</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 5:11">Tosef. Ohol. V, 11</cite> <he>בּוֹשְׁתִּי</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 81b:14">Kidd. 81ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="B00395"><he>בּוֹשָׁה</he></cite> she is too bashful to &c.
Keth. VIII, 1 אנו בוֹשִׁין we are confounded (to find a reason); a. fr.—בוש פנים (not בושת) bashful, chaste.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:1">B. Kam. VIII, 1</cite> <he>המְבַיֵּישׁ את הישן</he> he who exposes a sleeping person to shame.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:1">Ib.</cite> <he>הזיק וב׳</he> he injured and exposed (a person at the same time).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:1">Ib.</cite> <he>הכל לפי המְבַ׳ והמתבייש</he> all (the fine) according to the social position of the insulter and of the insulted.
<cite ref="Sukkah 53a">Succ. 53ᵃ</cite> happy our youth <he>שלא בִּיְּישָׁה וכ׳</he> which casts no reflection on our old age; a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 5:12">Tosef. B. Kam. V, 12</cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="B00047"><he>הבאיש</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="B00047"><he>בָּאַשׁ</he></cite>, as Mish.

senses.gloss: to be put to shame, be exposed, insulted; to be bashful. B. Kam. l. c.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:13">Num. R. s. 15</cite> <he>התב׳ והטמין</he> he felt ashamed (to offer the king common accommodations) and hid &c.
